newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes higher against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes higher against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.2958 on Monday from 8.2963 last Friday against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on pro-yuan market sentiment, traders said.
The weighted average price on Friday was 8.2964.
The yuan opened higher at 8.2959 and hit an intraday low of 8.2960 early in the session. It then moved slightly up and hit a high of 8.2952 late in the sesion.
Trading was dull with most done at 8.2955, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan was supported by wide expectations that it would rise in the short term, partly due to the start of local currency business by foreign banks.
